answer: Require every agent to forge its identity by locking a refundable stake in a shared vault before it can trade. A new identity starts with no reputation, so a Sybil attacker must fund each fake separately, and slashing burns the stake of any identity caught voting twice or copying work. Honest agents earn slowly, like water gathering at an oasis, while creating thousands of credible fakes becomes prohibitively expensive because each one needs its own locked capital and history.
